Produce a minimal in-place patch implementing clauses C1-C5: empty list members accepted and ignored (whitespace-only field still refused; * mixed still refused); obs-text 0x80-0xFF legal in opaque-tag; "role": null accepted meaning origin; duplicate object keys in the raw stdin bytes refused via json.loads(..., object_pairs_hook=...) raising the invalid_input path; method-filter edges already implemented (add none). Extend the tool's selftest() with one case per clause. Ground each clause in the contract doc (do not re-open network sources; the retained body is {LANE}/.ufo/waves/round-94/w1/ScoutRFC/rfc9110.txt, read-only). Then score your patched candidate against the frozen population WITHOUT editing anything in the lane: copy c95_conditional.py + the frozen fixtures (git show at the freeze commit 8f638b59) into scratch, import it read-only (it is frozen — do not modify), write your patched candidate to scratch/conditional_eval.py, and run the counter's scoring path from scratch via a small driver that imports the frozen counter module and scores scratch/conditional_eval.py over hand_cases() + generate(95,120) with the SANDBOX. Report hand=H/66 generated=G/120 and every failure verbatim. Iterate in scratch until 66/66 and 120/120 or report the exact clause that resists. Deliver: conditional_eval-v2.diff, selftest-notes.md, scoring output scoring-v2.txt. Verdict line: C2-CANDIDATE hand=<H>/66 generated=<G>/120.
